title: Dream to Remember: Continual Steering of Generalist Robot Policies with World Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13816v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generalist robot policies are trained with imitation learning and are bounded by the quality and coverage of their demonstrations. Reinforcement learning can improve and extend them, either by fine-tuning the policy weights or by training a small module to steer the input noise of a frozen generative policy. When tasks arrive sequentially, both approaches suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Fine-tuning on a task degrades prior tasks, and steering only shifts forgetting to the shared steering module. We propose Dream to Remember (D2R), which continually steers a frozen generalist policy toward new tasks, while retaining its earlier skills. As the steering module learns a new task, a frozen pretrained world model rehearses prior tasks through imagined rollouts, anchoring the module to its earlier behavior without a replay buffer or new data. When the world model is faithful enough, D2R learns the new task entirely in imagination. Otherw

translated_title: 梦境记忆：基于世界模型的通用机器人策略持续引导
translated_abstract: 通用机器人策略通过模仿学习进行训练，其能力受限于演示数据的质量和覆盖范围。强化学习可以改进和扩展这些策略，方法要么是微调策略权重，要么是训练一个小型模块来引导冻结的生成式策略的输入噪声。当任务按顺序到来时，这两种方法都会遭受灾难性遗忘：在某个任务上进行微调会损害先前任务的表现，而引导方法只是将遗忘转移到了共享的引导模块上。我们提出了 Dream to Remember（D2R），它能够将冻结的通用策略持续引导至新任务，同时保留其先前的技能。当引导模块学习新任务时，一个冻结的预训练世界模型通过想象推演来温习先前任务，将引导模块锚定在其先前的行为上，无需重放缓冲区或新数据。当世界模型足够准确时，D2R 可以完全在想象中学习新任务。否则……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出D2R方法，利用冻结的预训练世界模型通过想象推演来温习旧任务，从而在持续引导冻结的通用机器人策略学习新任务的同时避免灾难性遗忘，且无需重放缓冲区或新数据。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes D2R, which uses a frozen pretrained world model to rehearse prior tasks through imagined rollouts, enabling continual steering of a frozen generalist robot policy toward new tasks while avoiding catastrophic forgetting without requiring replay buffers or new data.
